subject: Steering tabletop & procurement timeline for Gridlytics — exec sponsor prep
summary: Post-discovery follow-up to confirm executive sponsor availability and align on procurement milestones, security evidence needed, and steering committee agenda.
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Steering tabletop & procurement timeline for Gridlytics — exec sponsor prep

Jane — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the steering committee in place and keep your procurement window intact:

- Decision criteria you called out: predictable inference latency under 250ms P95, regional data residency for EU workloads, and a clear unit-cost model that supports burst capacity.
- Economic buyer: you indicated CFO involvement (I have Jane Miller listed as exec sponsor).
- Security/legal inputs: Carlos (Security) and Sandra (Procurement) will need the SOC 2 + architectural diagram + example retention policy.

Proposed near-term plan:
1) Steering tabletop (executive + security + procurement) — 60 min to align roles, acceptance criteria, and gating items.
2) Mutual action plan (attached MAP_v1.xlsx) showing milestones: PoC sign-off, security attestation, contract, and go-live window.
3) Redwood to supply a short security evidence pack (attached RFIN_Security_Evidence_List.pdf) and a one-page runbook for the PoC.

Can you confirm the right exec sponsor and share availability windows next week (Nov 23–26)? If helpful, we can propose two options and include the pre-read one business day ahead.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), RFIN_Security_Evidence_List.pdf (evidence checklist), steering-tabletop-agenda.docx (draft agenda)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Marissa and Priyom to own logistics and capture procurement artifacts.

— Ben
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@gridlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@gridlytics.com>, Sandra Lo <sandra.lo@gridlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Steering tabletop & procurement timeline for Gridlytics — exec sponsor prep

Ben — thanks for the concise recap. Confirm I’m the exec sponsor on our side and I’m happy to join the steering tabletop. A few notes from my side:

- Availability: Mon Nov 23 10:00–11:30 PT or Wed Nov 25 14:00–15:30 PT. We prefer the 23rd if you can do it.
- Security ask: Carlos will need the SOC 2 report and an architectural diagram that clearly shows where KV cache and any customer data reside. He’ll also want to see how you handle key management for private deployments.
- Procurement cadence: Sandra will lead the redline process. Our procurement policy requires a two-week review after receiving draft terms. If you want to accelerate, we’ll need a pre-negotiation checklist.

Please send the pre-read by EOD Monday (Nov 22) so our security and procurement teams can preview. Also confirm whether the PoC requires a separate MSA or if we can use a short-form SOW under the existing purchasing agreement.

Looking forward to the tabletop.

— Jane Miller
CFO, Gridlytics
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 07:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Steering tabletop & procurement timeline for Gridlytics — exec sponsor prep

Looping in a quick legal/procurement checklist for the team ahead of the tabletop: 

- Contract model: prepare both an SOW-under-MSA option and a standalone short-form PoC SOW. Best to have a redline-ready baseline.
- Data residency: need to confirm whether EU workloads must be kept in EU cloud (customer requested regional residency). If so, identify preferred region and KMS scope.
- Liability and SLA: propose a limited liability clause and a 30-day service credit SLA for PoC.
- Timeline note: Sandra’s two-week review window is typical — include that in MAP so expectations are aligned.

I’ll draft a minimal redline and a bullet summary for the pre-read. Ben/Marissa — please send the architecture diagram and SOC 2 stub to me and Carlos before EOD Monday so I can annotate.

— Lauren
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@gridlytics.com>, Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@gridlytics.com>, Sandra Lo <sandra.lo@gridlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: Steering tabletop — Mon Nov 23 10:00 PT / Pre-read shared

Thanks all — confirm we’ll run the 60-minute steering tabletop as requested on Mon Nov 23 10:00–11:00 PT (we shortened to 60 min to respect schedules). Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=steering

Pre-read package (shared):
- MAP_v1.xlsx — mutual action plan with owner assignments and dates
- RFIN_Security_Evidence_List.pdf — evidence checklist and SOC 2 stub
- steering-tabletop-agenda.docx — 1-page agenda (executive goals, security gating, procurement timeline)

Agenda highlights:
1) 10:00 — 10:10 AM: Exec sponsor framing (Jane)
2) 10:10 — 10:25 AM: Security and architecture clarifications (Carlos + Lauren)
3) 10:25 — 10:40 AM: Procurement & contract path (Sandra + Priyom)
4) 10:40 — 11:00 AM: Acceptance criteria and next milestones (Ben/Marissa)

Action items assigned in MAP: PoC SOW draft (Ben), SOC 2 + arch diagram (Ben/Marissa), redline baseline (Lauren), procurement kickoff checklist (Priyom). We also added a DocuSign timeline link for expected contract signature (https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/DocuSign-Gridlytics-SLA).

If any of the owners need to swap assignments, flag here and we’ll update the MAP. Looking forward to the conversation.

— Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
